create_BlockSparseTensor: create a BlockSparseTensor from values and layout tensors for sparse block matrix operations
build_sparse_matmul: build sparse block matrix multiplication using BlockSparseTensor with a dense tensor via bmm or matmul
run_sparse_softmax: run sparse softmax over BlockSparseTensor values along the last dimension
test_sparse_to_dense: test converting a BlockSparseTensor to a dense tensor via to_dense
review_masked_matmul: review masked matrix multiplication on BlockSparseTensor using masked_matmul with a layout mask
